title: K004: Extend E2E test assertions across deployments
description:
**Size:** 📦 medium
**Category:** testing
**Priority:** high
**Source:** Proposed for 'With the latest commits/features, E2E tests were added'

Extend all three E2E test scripts with additional counter assertions. Docker (test/e2e/docker/test.sh): add capabilities_count >= 1, drift_count >= 1, metrics_count >= 1, logs_count >= 1, audit_count >= 1 after existing 3 assertions (total 8+). Systemd (test/e2e/systemd/test.sh): same 5 additional counter assertions within existing 60s timeout / 3s polling. Kubernetes (test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh): add state_count >= 1 (currently missing), plus same 5 additional counters (total 8+ from current 2). All assertions query the expanded /test/assertions JSON response using the same jq-based pattern already established in each script.

**Rationale:** Current E2E tests only verify registration, heartbeat, and state (Docker/systemd) or just registration and heartbeat (Kubernetes). The agent performs capabilities reporting, drift detection, and observability forwarding on every lifecycle iteration, but none of these are asserted. This means broken capabilities, drift, metrics, logs, or audit pipelines would not be caught by E2E tests. Adding assertions is low-effort and high-impact since the mock handlers from K001 already increment the counters.

**Affected Areas:**
- test/e2e/docker/test.sh
- test/e2e/systemd/test.sh
- test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh

requirements.description: Docker test.sh SHALL assert capabilities_count >= 1, drift_count >= 1, metrics_count >= 1, logs_count >= 1, and audit_count >= 1 in addition to the existing 3 counters
requirements.rationale: The agent performs capabilities reporting, drift detection, and observability forwarding on every lifecycle iteration. Without assertions, broken pipelines pass E2E silently.

scenarios.name: All 8 counters satisfied within timeout

scenarios.then: the script prints SUCCESS with all 8 counter values and exits 0

scenarios.name: New counter stays at 0 while original 3 pass

scenarios.then: the script continues polling until POLL_TIMEOUT, then prints FAIL with all 8 counter values and exits 1

scenarios.when: the assertion endpoint returns no response within the polling timeout

requirements.description: Systemd test.sh SHALL assert capabilities_count >= 1, drift_count >= 1, metrics_count >= 1, logs_count >= 1, and audit_count >= 1 in addition to the existing 3 counters

requirements.description: Kubernetes test.sh SHALL assert state_count >= 1 in addition to existing registration_count and heartbeat_count

requirements.description: All three scripts SHALL use the existing jq extraction pattern for new counters: $(echo "${RESPONSE}" | jq -r '.field_name // 0')
requirements.rationale: Consistency with established patterns reduces maintenance burden and cognitive load

implementation_notes:
This feature modifies only shell scripts and markdown docs. No Go code, no frontend, no backend API changes.

Dependency: This feature assumes PXD-0042 (K001: 15 new mock API handlers) is already implemented, providing the capabilities_count, drift_count, metrics_count, logs_count, and audit_count fields in the /test/assertions JSON response.

Pattern to follow: Each script has two sections that need modification: (1) the polling loop where counters are extracted and the success condition is evaluated, and (2) the failure block where counter values are printed for debugging.

Docker (test/e2e/docker/test.sh):
- Lines 58-67: Polling loop — add 5 jq extractions after line 60, extend if-condition on line 62, add 5 echo lines after line 66
- Lines 78-83: Failure block — add 5 jq extractions and 5 check_assertion calls after line 83
- Uses check_assertion() helper function (already defined at line 14)

Systemd (test/e2e/systemd/test.sh):
- Lines 197-206: Polling loop — add 5 jq extractions after line 199, extend if-condition on line 201, add 5 PASS echo lines after line 205
- Lines 218-223: Failure block — add 5 jq extractions and 5 echo lines after line 223
- Uses inline 'counter=value (want >= 1)' format

Kubernetes (test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh):
- Lines 157-165: Polling loop — add STATE_COUNT + 5 jq extractions after line 158, extend if-condition on line 160, add 6 PASS echo lines after line 163
- Lines 176-179: Failure block — add STATE_COUNT + 5 jq extractions and FAIL echo lines after line 179
- Uses 'FAIL: counter=value (want >= 1)' format

Key files:
- test/e2e/docker/test.sh (88 lines) — Docker E2E script
- test/e2e/systemd/test.sh (269 lines) — Systemd E2E script
- test/e2e/kubernetes/test.sh (183 lines) — Kubernetes E2E script
- docs/reference/backend/docker-e2e-test.md — Docker E2E reference doc
- docs/reference/backend/systemd-e2e-test.md — Systemd E2E reference doc
- docs/reference/backend/kubernetes-e2e-test.md — Kubernetes E2E reference doc

Risks:
- If PXD-0042 is not yet implemented, the new assertions will always fail (counters default to 0). This is by design — the assertions should only be merged after K001.
- The existing Docker test.sh asserts state_count but the Docker E2E doc (docker-e2e-test.md) lists metadata_count in its table instead. This is a pre-existing doc discrepancy. This feature should make the doc match the actual script behavior (state_count, not metadata_count) for Docker and systemd.
- Kubernetes test.sh currently does NOT set TEST_FAILED=0 in the failure path (it calls exit 1 directly). The success path sets TEST_FAILED=0 and exits 0. This behavior should be preserved.
